title: El Salar de Uyuni y la encrucijada del litio
goal: Explore the Salar de Uyuni, prehistoric lake geology, lithium reserves, and sovereign energy transition challenges.
grammar: geología del Salar de Uyuni, salmueras de litio y perífrasis de conjetura y probabilidad

items: Analyze the geological formation and optical mirror phenomenon of the Salar de Uyuni.
Deploy probability periphrases (deber de + inf, venir a + inf) in technical resource evaluation.
Deploy mineral brine, clean energy transition, and lithium extraction vocabulary (salmuera, litio, endorreico, geopolítica).
